text: e9798764 (not pushed): per owner decision 2026-10-10, Nearest/Average/Mode skip non-finite samples (Nearest = first finite sample in declared path order; Mode ties -> smallest). Mixed finite/NaN vertices now get finite values instead of NaN. GPU (midpoint+Nearest) already matched; now refuses finite values that overflow float32. Regressions failed before (CPU 2+1, GPU mock 1). Gates: surface/spatial/surfaceView JVM+JS, surfaceViewThreeJS 20/20, scalafimCompileAll exit 0 warning-clean. Spatial VolumeToSurfaceOperator is a linear map without reducers; NaN still propagates through forward (documented).
